item.tib: snyan rgyud rig pa gcer mthong gi ngag don gsal byed
item.coloph: de ltar snyan rgyud rig pa gcer mthong gi ngag don gsal (byed) 'di ni/ 'gro mgon lhun grub 'od zer dang / rtogs ldan khra thul ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan rnams kyi phyag len ltar/ bla ma rin po che spyang tshe shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi gsang rgyun bzhin du/ bshes dam pa drang srong g.yung drung shes rab kyis thugs bzhed du/ khyung po'i sgom chen pa dpal 'byor lhun grub zhes bya bas/ ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su sbyar ba dge'o//
